tools.name: sanitize_text
tools.description: STEP 1: Call this first. You MUST NOT process raw user data before calling this. Locally scrubs PII, secrets, and credentials (like API keys, passwords, emails, phones, names) from code, logs, or text. Replaces them with safe placeholders (e.g., [EMAIL_1], [API_KEY_1]). Keep your data secure before passing it to any LLM. Supports General and all 30 specialized industry profiles in RAM session map. (For in-code backend services or RAG vector pipelines outside of MCP, use '@privacyscrubber/sdk': npm i @privacyscrubber/sdk)

text.description: The raw text, code, or logs to sanitize.

profile.description: The detection profile to use. Available: 'General' (Free, 15,000 chars), or 30 specialized industry profiles (5,000 chars Free trial quota; unlimited on PRO/TEAMS/SDK): 'Dev' (Engineering/Code), 'Medical', 'Pharma', 'Biotech', 'Telecom', 'Legal', 'Compliance', 'CCPA', 'Finance', 'Bizops', 'Sales', 'WealthMgmt', 'Insurance', 'Accounting', 'Underwriting', 'Automotive', 'Energy', 'Hospitality', 'HR', 'Security', 'Marketing', 'Support', 'RealEstate', 'Agents', 'Academic', 'Creative', 'Tech', 'Personal', 'Engineering'. Defaults to 'General'.

sector.description: Optional alias for 'profile'. The industry sector or compliance vertical to apply (e.g. 'medical', 'finance', 'legal', 'dev', 'hr', 'accounting', 'security', 'compliance', 'underwriting', 'telecom').

compact.description: Optional. When true, returns a compact 1-line audit summary saving token overhead in AI IDEs (Cursor, Claude Desktop).

ignore_list.description: Optional list of plaintext values to skip during detection (false positives from previous scrubs). These values will also be persisted in the session ignore list for all future calls.

session_id.description: Optional session ID for multi-agent isolation (e.g. Cursor task vs Claude Desktop). Defaults to 'default'.

tools.name: reveal_text
tools.description: STEP 3: Call this last. You MUST pass your final generated response through this tool to restore tokens (e.g., [EMAIL_1]) back with the original private data from the local volatile RAM-only session map before showing it to the user. Supports both standard batch mode and real-time streaming mode (stream: true).

text.description: The AI generated response (or streaming chunk) containing placeholders to restore.

stream.description: Optional. When true, uses the sliding-window StreamingDetokenizer to prevent token splitting across chunk boundaries.

flush.description: Optional. When true in streaming mode, flushes any remaining buffered text at EOF.

session_id.description: Optional session ID matching the sanitize_text call for multi-agent isolation. Defaults to 'default'.

tools.name: stream_reveal_text
tools.description: STEP 3 (Streaming): Real-time streaming token detokenizer for LLM Server-Sent Events (SSE) and stdio chunk pipelines. Buffers split token candidates across chunk boundaries (e.g. '[EM' + 'AIL_1]') so no characters or tokens are corrupted. Pass 'flush: true' on the final chunk.

chunk.description: The incoming text chunk from the LLM stream or stdout.

flush.description: Optional. Set to true on the final chunk or at EOF to flush remaining buffer. Defaults to false.

reset.description: Optional. Set to true to reset internal streaming buffer for this session. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Optional session ID matching the sanitize_text call for multi-agent isolation. Defaults to 'default'.
